_about: decoder_inventory.py - the mechanical layer of the Chain Decoder (Operations Manual, to-do step 25, 2026-10-20).

functions.name: _bio_root
functions.doc: The directory that CONTAINS MethylPhys/ - i.e. Biological_Physics.

functions.name: _assign_run_id
functions.doc: RUN-YYYYMMDD-NN, sequential within the day, read from the ledger this run is about to append to.

functions.name: _covariates
functions.doc: Phenotype and covariates for this run: --covariates JSON first, then --covariate key=value on top.

functions.name: _versions
functions.doc: Every input that can change a reading, with a short hash - so runs months apart are poolable.

functions.name: _hash_id
functions.doc: sha256 (first 32 hex) of a typed identifier; an identifier that is already a hash (>= 16 alphanumerics) is kept (SOP 12).

functions.name: _redact
functions.doc: Every whole-token occurrence of the typed id in strings of obj replaced by its hash (decision B: no typed id in bundle or ledger).

functions.name: _dev_run
functions.doc: Development flags (doors/DEV_FLAGS_01.md): each writes bundle['development'][stage], labelled DEVELOPMENT - not commissioned. None of them changes the reading, the gauge or the tare.

functions.name: _stopped
functions.doc: A quarantine ends intake. Without this the next step overwrites the status and the verdict names a downstream symptom instead of the cause (seen 2026-09-23: an array-type mismatch was reported as a detection failure because step 0.2 had already written MANIFEST_COMPLETE).

functions.name: specimen_refusal
functions.doc: None when intake accepts the specimen (ACCEPTED_SPECIMENS); otherwise the plain refusal text naming the specimen (decision L).

functions.name: read_idat_nsnps
functions.doc: Read only the magic + nSNPsRead (field code 1000) from an IDAT file. Returns (nsnps:int|None, status:str). Does NOT decode intensities (Stage 1).

functions.name: step_0_1_idat_arrival
functions.doc: SOP §11. Verify the Grn+Red IDAT pair + manifest, stamp arrival, gate.

functions.name: _is_null_answer
functions.doc: For storage: blank or 'prefer not to say' -> None. 'No' is preserved as a real answer.

functions.name: _answer_present
functions.doc: For context-mode triggers: an affirmative answer (not null, PNTS, or a No/NA).

functions.name: _age_from_dob
functions.doc: Decimal-year chronological age from DOB and intake date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd).

functions.name: parse_questionnaire
functions.doc: Map a digital questionnaire submission (keyed by the engine-use field names the questionnaire defines) to the canonical covariate record. Missing or 'prefer not to say' answers become None (engine handles them conservatively). Derives chronological_age, smoking_bin, and the Stage 7 context-mode list.

functions.name: _looks_like_cleartext_pii
functions.doc: SOP §12: patient_id must be hashed before the engine. Cleartext (spaces, email, or too-short/non-token) -> quarantine.

functions.name: _write_manifest
functions.doc: Write the immutable per-sample patient_manifest.json (one per sample_run_id).

functions.name: step_0_2_manifest_creation
functions.doc: SOP §12. Build the canonical immutable patient_manifest.json from the staged Step 0.1 record + parsed questionnaire. Validate, PII-check, write, gate to 0.3.

functions.name: _prior_hashes_for_sentrix
functions.doc: (grn_sha, red_sha) from prior integrity-log rows for this Sentrix ID.

functions.name: step_0_3_integrity_hash
functions.doc: SOP §13. SHA-256 both IDATs, compare to prior intakes of the same Sentrix ID, register in the integrity log, stamp integrity_status, gate to 0.4.

functions.name: extract_control_probes
functions.doc: Extract Illumina control-probe intensities grouped by control class from the IDAT pair.

functions.name: validate_control_probes
functions.doc: SOP §14 control-probe math + gates. Input: per-control-class intensity medians extracted from the IDAT pair. Returns the CTRL_QC verdict.

functions.name: step_0_4_control_probe_validation
functions.doc: SOP §14. Validate control probes, stamp CTRL_QC, gate to 0.5. If no control summary is supplied, attempt extraction (deferred to the Stage 1 decoder); when that is unavailable, mark CTRL_QC DEFERRED and advance rather than fabricate a pass.

functions.name: _normal_sf
functions.doc: Survival function 1 - Φ(z), vectorized. scipy if available, else erfc fallback.

functions.name: compute_detection_p
functions.doc: detection_p = 1 - Φ((I - μ_bg)/σ_bg) per probe (SOP §15 stated formula).

functions.name: validate_detection_p
functions.doc: Gate on the detected fraction (intake_thresholds_v1.json detection): > pass_fraction PASS, >= borderline_fraction BORDERLINE, else FAIL.

functions.name: step_0_5_detection_pvalue_qc
functions.doc: SOP §15. Compute per-probe detection p, summarize, gate to 0.6. If intensities or negative-control stats are absent (extraction deferred to the Stage 1 decoder), mark DETECTION_QC deferred and advance rather than fabricate a pass.

functions.name: _manifest
functions.doc: The array's own manifest, cached per array type.

functions.name: _channel_means
functions.doc: Per-address mean intensity (and bead count) from one IDAT file, gzip or plain.

functions.name: _ensure_methylprep
functions.doc: Make sure methylprep is importable; pip-install it once if it isn't.

functions.name: _detect_array_type
functions.doc: Read the IDAT bead-address count and map it to methylprep's array type.

functions.name: calibrate_idat_to_beta
functions.doc: Calibrate one IDAT pair to noob-normalized beta.

functions.name: _stage_idat
functions.doc: Copy (or gunzip) an IDAT into the staging dir under the methylprep name.

functions.name: noise_sites
functions.doc: Runtime Matrices/Met_A_Floors/noise_sites_EPIC_v1.json: 48,528 EPIC sites every purified blood group holds fixed (group mean <= 0.03 or >= 0.97, group SD <= 0.02; no neutrophil identity site). Their entropy is the array's own noise.

functions.name: noise_gate
functions.doc: Runtime Matrices/Met_A_Floors/noise_gate_EPIC_v1.json: N_max = top of the reference arrays' noise range (DEV-NOISE-01).

functions.name: noise_index
functions.doc: N = mean H(beta) over the noise sites measured on this array; None when fewer than MIN_NOISE_FRACTION are measured.

functions.name: stage_a_composition
functions.doc: EPIC blood composition (blood_composition_EPIC_v1): 8 groups from Salas purified EPIC cells; markers exclude the neutrophil sites; NNLS, sum 1. Same platform and same reference as the expectation profiles. Refused (fractions None) when fewer than MIN_MARKER_FRACTION of the markers are measured.

functions.name: stage_m_blood
functions.doc: Whole blood: Met-A = mean H(beta) / mean H(e) at the neutrophil sites, e = sum_g f_g mu_g (EPIC purified group profiles). The untared value carries a composition and laboratory offset; the gauge state is printed only after the tare against healthy whole bloods run the same way (Stage T).

functions.name: _ceiling
functions.doc: Entropy ceiling: per-site H peaks at beta = 0.5. Met-A is monotone in pattern loss only while the cell's methylated sites stay above 0.5 (DNMT-01: A_meth saturates at 1/H(floor) once the methylated sites reach beta ~0.5).

functions.name: stage_m_isolated
functions.doc: Isolated / sorted neutrophils against their healthy reference. The healthy-reference state is kept as state_own_floor; the reading's state is 'untared' until Stage T reads it against >= 3 same-run references.

functions.name: stage_mc_cscore
functions.doc: Met-A C-score (stage 6): clustering of the residual z map in genomic order - variance of the means of blocks of clustering_block consecutive sites (x sqrt(block)) over the site variance, divided by the healthy median clustering of neutrophil_reference_v1_2.json. Healthy = 1; development (band not set). No residual map -> C None with the reason.
data_files: divided by the healthy median clustering of neutrophil_reference_v1_2.json

functions.name: _ref_records
functions.doc: References as plain A values or as records {A, f_neu, N[, id]}. Returns (records, n_self_excluded).

functions.name: stage_t_tare
functions.doc: Same-run tare against >= MIN_REFS healthy references of the same specimen type run the same way (same slide, else same batch). references: untared A values, or records {A[, id]}. A_rel = A / median(reference A); spread = SD of reference A / median. Nothing is fitted. Detection limit = 2 x reference spread / shift per 1 % loss.

functions.name: stage_t_cscore
functions.doc: Same-run tare of the Met-A C-score, the same rule as the median tare of A (DEV-CSCORE-TARE-01): C_rel = C / median(C of >= MIN_REFS same-run healthy references, records carrying C). The untared C depends on the laboratory; the tared C does not. Nothing is fitted.

functions.name: stage_t_selftare_ii
functions.doc: Stage T step 1, self-tare II (adopted 2026-10-04, DEV-SELFTARE-02): per probe design, beta' = Lr + (beta - L)(Ur - Lr)/(U - L) from this array's own fixed-site anchors L, U and the reference arrays' Lr, Ur (dev_stages.selftare_map; a design with anchors missing or U - L <= 0.1 is left unmapped). Returns (beta', record); when the runtime file is missing, (beta, record with status NOT_RUN).

functions.name: platform_refusal
functions.doc: None when the specimen is EPIC v1; otherwise the refusal text.

functions.name: run_neutrophil
functions.doc: beta: pd.Series from Stage 1 (EPIC v1). ref_A: same-run healthy references - their Met-A before the median tare (met_a.A, which carries Stage T step 1, self-tare II, since 2026-10-04), or records {A, f_neu, N[, id]} (Stage T; plain A values or records with A). array_type: Stage 0's array type (header, else declared), or None for a beta table. sample_id: excluded from the references if a record car

functions.name: platform_of
functions.doc: Platform from the calibrated beta vector itself: 'EPIC_v2' if any probe name carries the EPIC v2 design suffix; otherwise 'EPIC' (v1) when the vector holds more than 700,000 probes, else '450K'.

functions.name: read
functions.doc: beta: pandas Series (probe -> beta) from Stage 1 of a purified / sorted specimen of one cell type. cell: floor name (see available()). Returns the Met-A record; A is None (with a reason) when the reading is not permitted.

functions.name: _figs
functions.doc: The gauge pictures for this sample (PNG beside the report); a withheld or unread instrument gets none.

functions.name: physics_rows
functions.doc: AstroGenetics: each reading in the physics it rests on. Every number from this run's record or a committed reference file.

functions.name: _gauge
functions.doc: The whole cell gauge, drawn from Runtime Matrices/Gauge/cell_gauge_marks_v1.json (the book's marks) - never a bare band. Left to right: the floor (off the left edge), more order than healthy, Normal, over-writing, the full surface. The direction is CANON/foundation.json gauge_direction, remembered by the black hole: right is over-writing toward the full surface.

functions.name: red_flags
functions.doc: STOP / FLAG / WITHHELD / CAUTION / NOTE, from the bundle only. Returned as a list of {level, code, text}.

functions.name: safeguards
functions.doc: Rendered-claim scan, formula self-test, anchors, deconvolver conformance, atlas separability. Each PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN.

functions.name: gauge_png
functions.doc: A floor-to-ceiling gauge for Met-A or IAM-A; A None draws no needle (a withheld state draws no gauge at all in the HTML).

functions.name: cscore_png
functions.doc: The C-Score bar: scattered on the left, clustered on the right; its Normal band; no derived ends (it is a clustering ratio).

functions.name: atlas_sky_png
functions.doc: The healthy reference of `cell` from IAM-Atlas v2.1 at the same sites, in the same order and on the same pixels as the sample's C-Score sky (stage_v4.cscore_sky), so the two pictures line up site for site. A picture; nothing is scored from it.

functions.name: changes_sky_png
functions.doc: The sample laid over its healthy reference (author 2026-10-18: overlay the two, quiet the matches, show the changes). Same sites, same order, same pixels as the C-Score sky. Background: the healthy cell from IAM-Atlas v2.1 in grays (darker = more tagged). Color only where the sample's pattern (entropy per site, the Met-A departure) differs from healthy by more than `thr` of its own spread (the C-S

functions.name: anchors
functions.doc: This array's anchors: mean beta over each fixed-site set (I_low, I_high, II_low, II_high) it measures, with the count.

functions.name: selftare_map
functions.doc: beta' = Lr + (beta - L)(Ur - Lr)/(U - L) per design at the sites whose design is recorded; other sites unchanged. Returns (beta', record).

functions.name: selftare_ii
functions.doc: Met-A re-read after the type II self-tare: each design mapped onto the reference arrays' scale by this array's own fixed-site anchors (DEV-SELFTARE-02).

functions.name: site_uncertainty
functions.doc: SD of (beta - frozen reference value) over this array's own fixed sites, per design and state. Returns {I_low: sd, ...}.

functions.name: s_for
functions.doc: Per-site s_i for `sites` given their reference values (design from the runtime file; low state if ref < 0.5).

functions.name: direction
functions.doc: D = mean over sites of |r - 0.5| - |beta - 0.5| (> 0: toward 0.5, toward disorder). ref: Series of reference values.

functions.name: direction_record
functions.doc: Signed move toward or away from 0.5 at the neutrophil identity sites against the cell's own reference, tared on same-run references (DEV-DIRECTION-02).

functions.name: trace_cell
functions.doc: 3b: another blood group in an isolated-neutrophil specimen, called above 3 x this array's own standard error (DEV-TOOLKIT-ADDED-02).

functions.name: foreign_cell
functions.doc: 3c: a non-blood template in whole blood by NNLS with the blood groups, called above 3 x this array's own standard error (DEV-TOOLKIT-ADDED-02).

functions.name: brightness
functions.doc: 11b: 95 % interval on Met-A from the v3 per-site uncertainty (this array's own fixed-site noise), by Monte Carlo (DEV-TOOLKIT-ADDED-02).

functions.name: residual_z
functions.doc: z_i = (beta_i - sum_g f_g mu_g,i) / sqrt(sum_g f_g^2 (sd^2 + s_bp^2) + 0.02^2), s_bp the between-person SD (atlas column `donor_sd`) (DEV-SKY-01 wrapper). AP: atlas parent columns.

functions.name: block_shuffle_order
functions.doc: Permutation of positions (already in genomic order) that moves whole runs of `run` consecutive sites within each chromosome.

functions.name: sky
functions.doc: Residual sky with the within-chromosome block-shuffle null and the look-elsewhere statistic by simulation (DEV-SKY-02).

functions.name: atlas_e
functions.doc: Stage 3 atlas_e composition (12 array-measured circulating atlas v2 cells, DEV-ATLAS-EPIC-02 method), 8-group sums.

functions.name: nilc_e
functions.doc: Stage 4 NILC-e composition on the atlas_e templates (DEV-NILC-01 method), 8-group sums and the noise per fraction.

functions.name: percell_b
functions.doc: Stage 5 B-cell Met-A against the composition-matched expectation on the development B-cell floor (DEV-PERCELL-01 method).

functions.name: epicv2_calibrate
functions.doc: EPIC v2 IDAT pair -> beta Series on EPIC v1 probe names (replicate v2 probes of one CpG averaged). SeSAMe openSesame(prep), pOOBAH-masked probes dropped. Returns (beta, meta).

functions.name: nest_pix2ang
functions.doc: HEALPix NESTED pixel centres -> (theta, phi); the standard nest2xyf / xyf2ang algorithm (Gorski et al. 2005).

functions.name: cscore_sky
functions.doc: z: the C-Score's per-site departure map (pd.Series by site, in the C-Score's genomic order). Writes a Mollweide view; returns a summary.

functions.name: deconvolve
functions.doc: beta: pd.Series of readings by site id. Returns shares (normalized), raw sum, 95 % intervals, sites used.

functions.name: stamp
functions.doc: Attach the chain stamp to a result dict. inputs: [{'name':..., 'sha256':..., 'size':...}] (file_sha of each input where possible). manifest: the Master Testing Manifest row IDs this result belongs to.

functions.name: write_json
functions.doc: Write a stamped result. A result with a 'verdict' field (MET, NOT MET, INCONCLUSIVE, NOT ASSESSED, REPRODUCED, DIFFERS) is recorded as a run on each named manifest row by CANON/chain_events.py.

functions.name: hg19_tiles
functions.doc: {chrom: array of [start, end) CpG-index tiles}, consecutive 2,000-CpG tiles, partial last tile dropped (own_reads_genome.tiles).

functions.name: count_bam_region
functions.doc: One region of one alignment file -> partial counts. args = (bam, ref_fasta, chrom, start, end).

functions.name: build_line
functions.doc: per_sample: DataFrame with cell, loose_share, held_err, held_opp (RAW counter output). Per cell: median loose share, opportunity-weighted held error; Theil-Sen line across cells (as opensea_line.py, without its scale factor).

functions.name: residual
functions.doc: rec: a count from count_pat / count_bam (RAW). Returns the self-reference reading against the chain's line.

functions.name: build_shape_reference
functions.doc: records: chain counts (count_pat/count_bam output with cell and tile_p10). Returns the reference dict (write it with write_json).

functions.name: shape_check
functions.doc: Returns dict(read=bool, reason, ...). ref: a reference dict (for tests); else the chain's stored reference.

functions.name: reading
functions.doc: IAM-A self-reference reading: A = measured held error / what the sample's own loose share predicts on the line. 1 = on the healthy line; above 1 = more holes than its own line predicts (right on the gauge).

functions.name: build_band
functions.doc: healthy: counts of healthy samples from every laboratory, each already through the shape check (a refused sample is not passed in). Band = 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of their readings, pooled (sealed 2026-10-16: 'Seal as drafted'). Returns the band with its counts.

functions.name: grand_verdict
functions.doc: records: [(count, shape type)] for each healthy sample. Each is shape-checked first (refused = listed, not counted); each read sample's reading A must lie inside IAM-A's band v1. MET if at least GRAND_SHARE of the read samples are inside and at least GRAND_MIN_READ were read; NOT ASSESSED if fewer were read.

functions.name: lab_sd
functions.doc: SD of the fit's own array-laboratory offsets d (measured, never typed).

functions.name: predictive_interval
functions.doc: Posterior predictive for one new sample from a new laboratory. Array: N(mu, sd^2 + lab^2 + FLOOR) (amendment 1). Sequencing: N(g(mu), slope^2 sd^2 + g(1-g)/cov + s(mu)^2 + FLOOR), unchanged (its laboratory scatter s(mu) was already in).

functions.name: u1_verdict
functions.doc: cov_by_sample: {sample: coverage} for one cell and platform, all laboratories pooled. withheld: samples the chain withheld (listed, not scored).

functions.name: atlas_v21_use_status
functions.doc: 'COMMISSIONED' or 'development' for a use of atlas v2.1: use 'U1' with key (cell, platform family), 'U2a' with a tissue, 'U3'.

functions.name: build_deconv
functions.doc: DeconvV2 on the cells in `keep` (frozen SOLVER), with the neutrophil identity sites removed from the locus pool.

functions.name: twin_merge
functions.doc: The atlas's own rule (twin_family_thresholds_v1.json; records/10_twin_test_sample_level.csv) applied on the markers of solver D. Returns (merge map {cell: into}, pair table).

functions.name: mixture_twin
functions.doc: Identifiability in a mixture (atlas only): a cell whose template, at solver D's markers, is reproduced by a non-negative, sum-1 combination of the other candidate cells with correlation >= r_thr (the atlas twin_r) cannot be told apart from that mixture of cells in a specimen: it is a twin of a mixture (the D6 rule: mixtures out). Removed one at a time, highest r first, re-tested. Returns (removed

functions.name: crlb
functions.doc: Fraction SD bound for solver D's design at the markers (one array, noise v + sigma^2, equality sum f = 1 by elimination).

functions.name: ledoit_wolf
functions.doc: Analytic Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage of the sample covariance of rows of X (n x p, centred) toward mu*I. Parameter-free.

functions.name: met_a
functions.doc: Whole-blood Met-A = mean H(beta) / mean H(e) at the neutrophil sites, e = sum f_g mu_g; profiles: dict cell -> Series over ns. Cells with f < 1e-4 are skipped; sites unmeasured in any used profile are dropped.

functions.name: ceiling_flag
functions.doc: The entropy-ceiling diagnostic for the composition-aware reading, recorded alongside it (2026-10-13).

functions.name: bandpowers
functions.doc: Mean C_l in each band - six numbers that a person can compare, from 254 that they cannot.

functions.name: apodised_mask
functions.doc: Weight in [0, 1] per pixel: 0 outside the footprint `good` (bool HEALPix RING array), rising to 1 at an angular distance apod_deg inside it. theta is the distance from a footprint pixel centre to the centre of the nearest masked pixel that touches the footprint; x = sqrt((1 - cos theta) / (1 - cos apod_deg)) (= theta / apod_deg at small angles). Tapers (Grain et al. 2009): "C1"  w = x - sin(2 pi x

functions.name: masked_spectrum
functions.doc: (C_l, f_sky, good-pixel mask) of a HEALPix map whose masked pixels are NaN; masked pixels are set to 0 (healpy.anafast). mask="hard" (default): the raw pseudo-C_l of the cut map, as before. mask="apodised": the map times apodised_mask(good, apod_deg, taper), pseudo-C_l divided by w2 = mean(weight^2). f_sky is the footprint fraction (good.mean()) in both cases.

functions.name: shuffled_null
functions.doc: Band powers of n_perm within-mask permutations of the map's own unmasked pixel values (shape n_perm x len(bands)); each permuted map's spectrum is taken with the same mask as masked_spectrum(mask=...).

functions.name: sky_spectrum_record
functions.doc: One sky: its spectrum, band powers, f_sky, the fraction of unmasked pixels with |z| > 2, and its shuffled null. With mask="apodised" the record also carries the mask ("apodised C2 2.0 deg") and w2; the hard-mask record is unchanged.

functions.name: scan_pat
functions.doc: One pass over a .pat(.gz): integrity, per-chromosome molecules, index-range breaches, call-length counts, opportunities.

functions.name: intake
functions.doc: Stage Q0 on one .pat(.gz). alignment_qc: dict (or JSON path) from the alignment step with 'conversion_rate' and/or 'duplicate_fraction'; None = not measured here. Returns {stage, checks:[...], decision, refusal_code?, refusal?, measured}.

functions.name: _pat_lines
functions.doc: Lines of a .pat or .pat.gz file; a gzip file may be multi-member (bgzip) and may be cut at max_bytes. Streamed (2026-10-04, DEV-IAMA-REAL-01: the earlier whole-file read joined every bgzip member into one buffer, which does not finish on a whole file). Same lines as before: every byte that decompresses is read, a member cut at max_bytes gives what it holds, the last piece is dropped.

functions.name: pat_site_table
functions.doc: Per-site table (pos, opp_A, err_A, opp_B, err_B) from one .pat(.gz) file, pipeline loyfer_pat_v1. pos = 'chrom:CpG index'. Sum of err / sum of opp over the table equals iama_floor.py's eps for the same file and byte range.

functions.name: _genomic_order
functions.doc: Rows of a site table in genomic order: pos 'chrom:index' sorted by chromosome then index; plain integer pos sorted numerically.

functions.name: cscore
functions.doc: IAM-A C-score for the pooled table (opp = opp_A + opp_B) and for each half. Returns {C, n_blocks, se_null, halves: {...}}.

functions.name: read
functions.doc: site_table: per-site table (see module doc). cell: e.g. 'neutrophils'. pipeline: the read-level pipeline that produced the table (required). mask: positions to drop. allow_partial: development only - read a table cut at max_bytes (to reproduce v1). Returns the IAM-A record; A is None with a refusal when the reading is not permitted.

functions.name: tare
functions.doc: IAM-A same-run tare (author decision 2026-10-09, option a; DEVELOPMENT - not commissioned; doors/DEV_IAMA_KIT_01.md). A_rel = A / median(A of >= MIN_REFS healthy references of the same cell read the same way: same laboratory, same library kit, same pipeline). refs: plain A values, or records {A, id[, pipeline]}; a record whose id equals sample_id is excluded; a record with a different pipeline is

functions.name: check_same_person
functions.doc: Refuse unless patient hash, array type and pipeline match. Returns (ok, reason).

functions.name: delta_cells
functions.doc: Per-cell dA for cells present in both draws; appeared / disappeared listed, not differenced.

functions.name: delta_sky
functions.doc: beta_now - beta_prior per address on the addresses both draws measured. No expectation, no sigma, no composition.

functions.name: snp_noise_floor_A
functions.doc: F2: the SNP-probe noise of the two arrays propagated to A over the cell's identity loci - a LOWER BOUND on the change floor. var(mean beta) = sum(a + b*beta(1-beta)) / n^2 per array; dA ~ |dH/dbeta| * sqrt(var_now + var_prior) / H_min at the mean.

functions.name: trajectory
functions.doc: Bundles in draw order; per-cell A_1..A_N with dates. Numbers in order - no fit, no slope.

functions.name: compare
functions.doc: rows: one row per person with gsm, A (untared Met-A), C (optional), slide, group_col. healthy: boolean Series of the arrays the tare may use as references (default: every array). Returns the comparison, the call and, when needed, the preliminary label.
